blocks.en: DRUNKENNESS, Strong Drink, Wine. Strong drink: "What satiates or intoxicates." Young. Prov. 20:1. Strong drink is a brawler. Isa. 5:11-14, 22. Woe unto them that follow strong drink. Isa. 24:9. Strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it. Isa. 28:7. Through strong drink they are gone astray. Hab. 2:15. Woe unto him that giveth his neighbor drink.
blocks.zh: 醉酒，浓酒，酒。浓酒：『凡使人餍足或使人醉的』——杨氏（Robert Young，《圣经分析经文汇编》编者）的界说。箴言 20:1 —— 浓酒发怒（英译：浓酒是好斗的）。以赛亚书 5:11-14, 22 —— 祸哉，那些……追求浓酒的人。24:9 —— 喝浓酒的必觉苦味。28:7 —— 因浓酒东倒西歪（英译：因浓酒走迷了路）。哈巴谷书 2:15 —— 给人酒喝……的有祸了。

grammar.note: them that follow / him that giveth：那追求浓酒的／那给邻舍酒喝的。
Woe unto …：圣经咒祸句式（……有祸了）——名词 woe＋介词短语，全句无动词。

blocks.en: Wine: For the meaning and discriminated use of the Hebrew and Greek words, see Ps. 104:15 with the comments. Prov. 20:1. Wine is a mocker. Prov. 23:20. Be not among winebibbers, among gluttonous eaters of flesh. Prov. 23:29-35. (Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? . . . They that tarry long at the wine. At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.) Eph. 5:18. Be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess. Rom. 13:13. Not in rioting and drunkenness. Gal. 5:21. Works of the flesh . . . drunkenness. 1 Cor. 6:10. Nor drunkards shall inherit the Kingdom of God.
blocks.zh: 酒：希伯来文与希腊文诸『酒』字的含义与分别用法，参诗篇 104:15 及其注解。箴言 20:1 —— 酒能使人亵慢。23:20 —— 好饮酒的，好吃肉的，不要与他们来往。23:29-35 ——（谁有祸患？谁有忧愁？……就是那流连饮酒的人。终久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。）以弗所书 5:18 —— 不要醉酒，酒能使人放荡。罗马书 13:13 —— 不可荒宴醉酒。加拉太书 5:21 —— 情欲的事……醉酒。哥林多前书 6:10 —— 醉酒的……都不能承受神的国。

grammar.note: Be not among winebibbers / Be not drunk with wine：be 动词祈使否定，不用 do。
wherein is excess：wherein = in which（其中有放荡）。
biteth / stingeth / giveth：咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。

blocks.en: Illustrations: Noah, Gen. 9:21. Lot, Gen. 19:32. The Rechabites, who drank no wine, Jer. 35. Dan. 1:8. (Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king's wine.)
blocks.zh: 例证：挪亚——创世记 9:21（醉酒赤身）。罗得——19:32（女儿以酒灌醉其父）。利甲族人——耶利米书 35 章（谨守祖训滴酒不入口，蒙神称许）。但以理书 1:8 ——（但以理却立志，不以王的酒玷污自己。）

grammar.note: purposed in his heart that he would not …：purpose 作动词『立志』＋that 从句（立志不玷污自己）。

brawler.def: n. 好斗吵闹的人（brawl：斗殴）【GRE】

astray.def: adv. 迷路地（go astray：走迷）【六级】

mocker.def: n. 亵慢者，好讥诮的（mock：讥诮）【六级】

rioting.def: n. 荒宴，放荡喧闹（riot）【六级】

drunkards.def: n. 醉酒的人，酒徒（drunkard）【六级】

purposed.def: v.【古】立志，定意（purpose 作动词）【四级】

discriminated.def: adj. 加以分别的（discriminate：辨别）【六级】
